# The Patternmaker Behind the Designer — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-106420
Voiceover: Construction evidence can outlive the operating house—but only if the physical object and record stay paired.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of Miss Eva Drexel Dahlgren, 1976

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CA03-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · BRIEF — What is the design asking the pattern to do?. Record silhouette, balance, ease, movement, material behavior, size range, construction, finish, cost, time, accessibility, and the non-negotiable visual idea. A sketch alone rarely carries all of this.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CA03-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · JUDGMENT — Which decisions belong to the patternmaker?. Log the alteration, reason, evidence, person deciding, person approving, affected sizes and materials, and whether the change is technical, aesthetic, safety-related, or commercial. Skilled translation should remain attributable.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CA03-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · FIT — Whose body becomes the standard?. Identify the block, fit model or measurement source, sample size, grading method, movement test, wearer feedback, and excluded bodies. A technically repeatable pattern can still institutionalize a narrow body assumption.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CA03-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · RETAIN — Can the knowledge survive the specialist’s absence?. Preserve pattern version, annotation, toile images where permitted, fitting decisions, known failures, material constraints, maker credit, access rules, and a route for future questions. The file is evidence; narration explains the judgment.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress
